What it does

Work has a little more life.

Look over, see what your agents are doing, and get a small reaction when something changes.

WORKING

Keep you company.

The companion follows active coding work. Expressions and sounds give the session a bit of character.

NEEDS ATTENTION

Catch the waiting moment.

When an agent needs you, your buddy can flag it. A tap opens the waiting agent so you can take over.

TASK FINISHED

Enjoy the little wins.

Model-guided reactions can celebrate a finished task. The mood helps decide how that moment feels.

A bit of character

Connected moods.
Small surprises.

Buddygotchi’s model chooses among related moods and available expressions. A change in the coding session can get a context-sensitive response.

Personality sets the tone; mood shapes the feeling; the ongoing task determines what the buddy is doing. Nightly personality learning is still a work in progress.

Build & try

An open project.
A product taking shape.

Today, you can explore the source and supported hardware. The finished desk companion is still in development.

The setup uses a Mac host and a supported ESP32 display. Start with the current repository guide for installation and hardware details.

Open the build guide ↗
HostMac · current README requires macOS 26 or later.
DisplaySupported ESP32 CYD and Waveshare boards; check the guide for exact models.
Agent hooksClaude Code and Codex work and attention events.
AI reactionsA Jev API key enables model-guided reactions. Work and attention status can run without it.
AvailabilityOpen-source development. Hardware sales and delivery details are still being worked out.

The current build requires setup. Demo clips illustrate behavior; we’ll share real-device demonstrations as the project progresses.
